findings.claim: Publish the widened operation type as a major release. `EncryptOperation.getOperation().plaintext` changed from `Plaintext | null` to `PlaintextInput | null`. `PlaintextInput` includes JSON documents, including arrays containing `null`, so existing consumers that assign this value to `Plaintext | null` no longer compile.
